homeTaglineLine1: Is there no cultural content in your town?
homeVanAlt: The colorful van of Kulturni Centar Talas
blogSubtitle: On culture: a little about drama, more about the performances we watch and create, the films we remember, the artists and trends that shape our cultural space. Talking about art is no less important than art itself, and through it we develop curiosity, critical thinking, and the ability to see the world from multiple perspectives.
callLead: If your town does not have enough cultural programs, or you simply want to bring a little color into everyday life, feel free to call us!
callOffer: Whether you need a theatre performance, a film screening, a creative workshop for children, or you want to enrich your event with an interesting cultural program, we are here!
callVan: Our colorful van travels from place to place, carrying theatre, films, art, and a handful of ideas. We visit schools, kindergartens, libraries, cultural centers, festivals, birthdays, and celebrations, as well as village yards, parks, and every place ready to become a space for art and fun for a day.
callWhyTitle: Why is it important to call Talas?
callWhyOrg: Kulturni centar Talas is an independent organization made up of young artists and cultural workers. We do not have ongoing institutional funding; we develop and carry out our programs thanks to projects, donations, collaborations, and guest appearances.
callWhyInvite: That is why every invitation from you means much more to us than another performance. When you host Talas, you directly support the work of young artists, help our programs keep going, and make it possible for us to create new performances, workshops, and other cultural content.
callWhyAccess: We believe the right to culture must not depend on where you live, the size of the city, or financial means. We want every child and every young person to have equal opportunities to watch theatre performances, take part in creative workshops, meet artists, and discover the world of art. That is why we travel, explore, and work to bring culture even to places that rarely appear on cultural maps. Every visit matters to us, whether it is a festival, a school performance, or a corporate event. The income we earn through these collaborations lets us devote part of our time and resources to programs in smaller and rural communities, where there are often no funds to organize cultural events. In this way, by inviting Talas to your town or your event, you indirectly help theatre, film, and art reach children and young people who do not have the chance to experience them regularly.
callHowSteps: It's simple! Explore our <offer>offer</offer>, find a performance, workshop, or other program you like, and send us an <inquiry>inquiry</inquiry>. Tell us where you are coming from, what you would like us to organize, and when, and we will get back to you so we can arrange all the details together.
callHowUnsure: And if you are not sure which program would suit your audience best, <write>write to us</write> and we will find a solution together.
callClosing: We pack our things into our colorful van and hit the road!

aboutIntro: <org>Kulturni Centar Talas</org> is an independent arts organization from Smederevo dedicated to creating and promoting contemporary, socially engaged art for children and young people. It was founded in March 2023 to spark new waves of creativity, solidarity, and critical thinking, especially among children and youth. It grew out of the need to create a socially engaged space.
aboutGoal: The organization’s goal is a mobile cultural center so that culture and the arts are available in rural communities too.
aboutArtEcology: In our work we combine art and ecology to decentralize culture and build ecological awareness.
aboutLatestProject: Our latest project, <projectLink>Na točkovima kulture</projectLink>, is a fundraising campaign to buy a van that we are turning into a traveling cultural center. The program includes theatre performances, workshops, and film screenings in places where this kind of content is not otherwise available.
supportIntro: This way you support young artists in bringing culture to places without arts institutions.
